parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records is `MockStructuredAnalytics.CPUSessionEventProxy+Playback` declared in `Shared/Analytics/Sources/AnalyticsTesting/MockStructuredAnalytics.swift` — the file path contains the `AnalyticsTesting` component and the type name carries the `Mock` prefix, both unambiguous markers of a deliberate test/mock fixture. Per decision rule 1, any cluster containing a mock-marked record must be treated as intentional duplication. The high Jaccard similarity of 0.875 between this proxy and the production `CPUSessionEvent` in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Analytics/PlaybackAnalytics.swift` is expected: the mock is designed to mirror the production shape so that test code can substitute it. Lifting shared structure into a common location would couple production `PlaybackCore` semantics to the `AnalyticsTesting` module, which is the canonical anti-pattern this rule guards against.
